title: Who we send away · close
summary: Who we send away, in one plain paragraph in this page's own words, then the page's one close: “One call tells both of us whether we fit.”, the red System Audit button and the quiet Talk to the team.

reference.site: Kit close (§12.10) · the homepage fit's 'Not for' wording
reference.borrowed: The approved decline titles and lines, and the kit's one-close grammar.
reference.kelwin: No D-0n codes, – marks, 'Instead' keys, gate side, question links or onward rows; the declines are four short paragraphs, the close is the kit's.

motion: entrance: the label fades and the four declines rise (kit cascade, a reveal, not a moment); the close keeps the kit's own rise.
interaction: the button and the link (hover states).
on the live site: plays once as it scrolls into view. Reduced motion: final state.
story: Keeps the homepage's promise of 'the honest list of who we send away', plainly, then turns the page's argument (fit is decided, and it can be a no) into the one ask: the audit request asks how your deals close (its second question, 'How do your deals close?') and answers 'Qualified' or 'Not a fit yet' — so the line says exactly that.
copy: [K] 'Rent-it-forever · We’ll run it on retainer, but if nobody inside will own it, we decline.' + round-8 'Instead', verbatim, as a sentence: 'Find the owner first. Then the system has somewhere to live.'
[K] 'Lead-list shopping · Renting activity is the cycle we exist to end. A list vendor is the better call.'

[K] 'Pure self-serve / PLG · The system assumes a sales-carried deal.' + [R] round-8 'Instead' 'Different machinery, built for checkout.' → 'A product bought at checkout needs different machinery.' — for the founder's yes
[R] 'Pre-revenue · There’s no working motion to instrument yet. When the first revenue is real, come straight back.' (round 8, from the gate)

[N] close line 'Tell us how your deals close. We’ll say if we’re a fit.' (12 words; one sentence per line). It names what the audit request asks and what it answers; shares no shape with the sibling doors (About 'Rameez reads every audit request.', Contact 'A diagnosis starts with three questions, not a message.', Careers 'Ask about any seat before you write in.'); no 'Find out…', 'before…', 'If…' or 'three'.
[K] 'Request a System Audit' (red, → /audit) · 'Talk to the team' (→ /contact)

Cut: D-01–D-04, the 'Instead' keys, 'Read the field notes meanwhile', 'The audit is a gate, and it works in both directions.' (homepage slogan), 'Not sure which side you’re on?', 'Who would you be working with? → About', the foot hairline, and round 9's first-pass line 'Find out where yours breaks first, before anything is built.' (a sibling template; 'yours' had no antecedent).
